County-of-Maui-v-Hawaii-Wildlife-Fund-20.decision_maker: Supreme Court of the United States
County-of-Maui-v-Hawaii-Wildlife-Fund-20.holding: A discharge through groundwater can require an NPDES permit when it is the functional equivalent of a direct discharge. The inquiry depends on the circumstances; time and distance usually matter most.

Sackett-v-EPA-2023.decision_maker: Supreme Court of the United States
Sackett-v-EPA-2023.holding: Federal jurisdiction over adjacent wetlands requires a qualifying relatively permanent water body and a continuous surface connection making the wetland indistinguishable from that water. The opinion addresses temporary interruptions and unlawful barriers.
